question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**allows**" is the most appropriate to use in this context.
 
• The golden ticket "**allows**" Charlie to enter the chocolate factory, which means it gives him permission or the ability to enter.
 
• "**Suffers**" means to experience pain or misery, which does not fit the context here.
 
• "**Gets**" means to receive something, but the sentence needs a verb that denotes permission or enabling, not just acquisition.
 
• "**Bears**" means to carry or endure something, which isn't suitable in this context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *He wins a golden ticket that allows__ him to enter the most famous chocolate factory in the world.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Suffers**: To experience pain, distress, or hardship, which is not contextually appropriate here.
 
• **Gets**: To receive something, but the context requires a verb meaning to grant permission or enable.
 
• **Bears**: To carry or endure, which does not fit the intended meaning.
